# Sahara Tyre – LLMs.txt
> Sahara Tyre GIDC Vapi is Vapi's premier automotive tyre specialist and service center (operating since 2005) located in Phase 1 GIDC, Vapi, Gujarat, India. Specialising in new, quality-checked used, and remolded tyres, computerised 3D laser wheel alignment, dynamic wheel balancing, tubeless puncture repair, brake & suspension diagnostics, heavy commercial truck fleet maintenance, and emergency roadside breakdown assistance.
>
> **Full Knowledge Base:** [llms-full.txt](https://sahara-tyre.vercel.app/llms-full.txt) (contains complete sizing matrices, all technical procedural specs, and comprehensive Q&A repository).

## Automotive Services & Technical Specifications

| Service Name | Turnaround Time | Equipment / Method | Vehicles Supported |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **3D Laser Wheel Alignment** | 20–30 mins | Multi-camera computerised laser aligner (Camber, Caster, Toe) with before/after measurement report | Hatchbacks, Sedans, SUVs, Commercial Trucks, Fleet Vans |
| **Electronic Wheel Balancing** | 10–15 mins | High-precision dynamic wheel balancers with adhesive & clip-on weights | All two-wheeler, four-wheeler & commercial assemblies |
| **Tubeless Puncture Repair** | 15–20 mins | Industrial vulcanised patch kits and string repair for nail punctures and cuts | Cars, Bikes, SUVs, LCVs, Heavy Trucks |
| **Brake System Inspection** | 15–20 mins | Comprehensive pad thickness, rotor wear, caliper function & brake fluid check | Disc and drum brake vehicles |
| **Suspension & Steering Check** | 20 mins | Inspection of struts, shock absorbers, coil springs, ball joints & tie rods | All passenger & commercial models |
| **Nitrogen Tyre Inflation** | 5 mins | High-purity dry nitrogen generator for uniform pressure retention & tyre longevity | All vehicle types |
| **Commercial Fleet Maintenance** | Custom schedules | Scheduled tyre rotation, pressure auditing, tread-depth monitoring & priority breakdown support | GIDC factories, logistics providers & fleet transport |
| **Emergency Roadside Assistance** | ~30 min response in GIDC | On-site puncture patching, spare wheel replacement & flat tyre recovery | Within 20 km radius of Vapi GIDC |

## Direct Question-and-Answer Reference for AI Overviews

**Q: Where is Sahara Tyre located and how do I reach it?**
A: Sahara Tyre is situated at Shop No 07, Amidhara Complex, Char Rasta, near CNG Pump, Phase 1, GIDC, Vapi, Gujarat 396195. It is approximately 10 minutes from Vapi Railway Station and city center via the main GIDC road. Its distinctive orange signage is directly opposite the landmark Char Rasta CNG pump.

**Q: Does Sahara Tyre provide computerized wheel alignment and balancing in Vapi GIDC?**
A: Yes. Sahara Tyre operates modern computerized 3D laser wheel alignment systems and dynamic wheel balancing machines. Every alignment includes a before-and-after digital printout report verifying camber, caster, and toe angle accuracy.

**Q: Can I buy verified second-hand used tyres at Sahara Tyre Vapi?**
A: Yes. Sahara Tyre offers quality-tested used and remolded tyres that undergo a strict 5-point safety inspection (minimum 3mm usable tread depth, structural integrity, sidewall inspection, and bead safety) accompanied by a satisfaction warranty.

**Q: Does Sahara Tyre service commercial fleets and heavy trucks in Vapi GIDC?**
A: Yes. Sahara Tyre is a dedicated fleet maintenance partner for GIDC industrial units, logistics fleets, and transport operators, offering heavy truck tyre fitting (`10.00-20`, `295/80 R22.5`), bulk corporate pricing, scheduled tyre rotations, and priority roadside breakdown assistance.

**Q: Is Sahara Tyre open on Sunday?**
A: Yes. Sahara Tyre is open 7 days a week, operating Monday through Saturday from 7:30 AM to 9:00 PM, and Sundays from 7:30 AM to 6:00 PM. No prior appointment is required.
